Coram : A.K. PATNAIK*, H.L. GOKHALE
Terrorists and Disruptive Activities (Prevention) Act, 1987 - s.3(1) - Retaliatory attack by group of extremists leading c tq death of 35 persons and injury to 7 persons - Accused­ appellants convicted and sentenced to death - Justification - Held: On facts, even if deficiencies in the appellant no. 2 is rather weak - His name not mentioned in the FIR - PW-2 injured witness 0 failed to identify appellant no.2 in Court - None of the other witnesses including PW-3, another injured witness, attributed any role to him - In the circumstances, appellant no.2 deserves acquittal -
Decision Date : 20-09-2013 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 791/2009 | Disposal Nature : Case Partly allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
